name: Counter Turing Test (CT^2)
description: CT^2 is a benchmark designed to evaluate the robustness of AI-generated text detection (AGTD) techniques. It offers a comprehensive evaluation of existing detection methods and introduces the AI Detectability Index (ADI) to rank language models by their detectability levels.
reputation: A niche but relevant benchmark in the AGTD literature, mainly cited for introducing the AI Detectability Index rather than as a broad community standard.
notes: Introduces AI Detectability Index (ADI) to quantify detectability of LLM-generated text; evaluates 15 contemporary LLMs.
